dsh_sdk_start_smoke.initial_diagnostic_failure: A synthetic isolated profile with reasoning_effort=none failed because the generated DSH model profile declared only off and no enabled thinking level. The first surfaced error was a compat validation message; removing compat diagnostically revealed the actual missing reasoning level.
dsh_sdk_start_smoke.repair: Declare SiliconFlow Kimi low as the binary thinking-enabled capability; do not claim high/max are distinct request parameters. Omit DSH effort for none because the Qwen adapter treats the literal string off as truthy.
